channel.title: Mitesh Gandhi | Reflections
channel.description: Reflections from an optometrist on seeing people, turning points, and where the science of the eye meets the inner life.

item.title: From the archive: The Rise and Fall of Our Ascent
item.description:
There is a moment when you realise you are rising.
You feel lighter. The mind becomes quieter. And then, without noticing, you begin to fall. Not suddenly. Just a little less meditation, a little more ego, a little more attention on the world outside.
In Sahaja Yoga, Self-Realisation is not the destination. It is the beginning of our ascent. And we don't have to fight our way back: we return to meditation, and allow the Kundalini to do the work.
Rise. Fall. Watch. Correct. Grow.
How quickly do you notice that you have fallen, and turn back towards the centre?

item.title: From the quiet son to live on BBC Radio
item.description:
The quiet son who never spoke up, live on BBC Radio Cambridgeshire.
2019. “On air in 3… 2… 1…” And the voice going out across the county was mine. I grew up deferring to a strong father. I was the one who listened, never the one who spoke.
No big leap changed that. A staircase of small, frightening steps did, and I never climbed it alone.
I didn't find courage, then act. I acted, and courage followed.
What's something you did scared that you're now glad you did?

item.title: The tree of life in the eye
item.description: Every day I look into the eye and see an optic disc, branching vessels, a cross behind the eyes. Science explains the how. Meditation lets me wonder at the why.
